question: Explain why eddy currents are useful in electromagnetic damping. Give one practical situation where this effect is used.

options.A: Eddy currents increase the motion of the conductor and are used in electric motors.
options.B: Eddy currents make a conductor permanently magnetic and are used in transformers.
options.C: Eddy currents oppose the motion producing them and convert mechanical energy into heat, causing damping; this is used in moving coil galvanometers to obtain dead-beat motion.
options.D: Eddy currents reduce the resistance of the conductor and are used in electric heaters.
